facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: near hit during cleaning and preparation on P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on P-3222 and M-3222 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 3 November 2005 a near hit was recorded on P-3222 and M-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
